opening.argument: The presentation ties holding cryptocurrency in the Plus Token wallet to recurring rewards, stating that users receive an average of six to eighteen percent per month, paid daily, and that activating AI Dog supplies the reward. It adds that users are in profit from day one and describes the arbitrage as involving zero risk when trades are executed properly. The promotion further claims that Plus Token can be converted to Ethereum at any time and that a later strategy could bring monthly revenue closer to twenty percent, while directing viewers to a PlusToken training website and displayed destination. Those returns and the risk characterization are not verified in the material. The fee language is also internally unsettled: it mentions one membership fee while stating there are no monthly fees to use and keep cryptocurrency in the wallet.
